note: This row is a fuse, and that is deliberate. S009 reads next_due at error severity, so the first check run after that date fails, and so does every run after it, until the pass is run and last_run and next_due move on. A red build the day after a due date is the cadence firing rather than a regression: run the procedure above instead of editing the date. A caller who wants the work list rather than the gate passes check --relax-semantic, which drops the whole S-series to warnings.
